name: Quantum Universal Copy
author: Mircea – Quantum WP Plugins

sections.description:
Quantum Universal Copy lets your users copy text, promo codes, or code snippets with a single click.

The plugin includes a dedicated Elementor widget and shortcodes, making it easy to add copy functionality anywhere on your website.

It is lightweight, fast, and works out of the box.

Perfect for:

  • Promo codes
  • Coupon codes
  • Code snippets
  • Documentation pages
  • Tutorials
  • Developer blogs

Improve user experience and make copying content effortless.

Features

  • Copy text or promo codes with one click
  • Copy code snippets
  • Elementor widget included
  • Shortcode support
  • Tooltip feedback after copy
  • Button or icon trigger
  • Responsive icon size controls
  • Optional copy protection unlock

Elementor Widget

The Quantum Universal Copy widget allows you to add copy functionality directly inside Elementor layouts.

Simply drag the widget and configure:

• Copy mode (Text or Code)
• Button label
• Icon mode
• Tooltip message

Shortcodes

Copy text:

[quantum_copy text=”PROMO50″]

Copy code blocks:

[quantum_copy_code lang=”bash”]
npm install quantum-copy
[/quantum_copy_code]

Shortcodes work in:

• WordPress posts
• Pages
• Widgets
• Elementor shortcode widget

Optional PRO Version

A PRO version with extended styling and layout options is available.

Features may include:

• Typography controls
• Advanced icon styling
• Custom spacing options
• Additional layout options

More details:
https://quantumwpplugins.com/quantum-universal-copy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/quantum-universal-copy
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Open Elementor and search for Quantum Universal Copy
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work without Elementor?

Yes. You can use the provided shortcodes anywhere in WordPress.

Can I copy promo codes with this plugin?

Yes. It is perfect for coupon codes and promotional codes.

Can I copy code snippets?

Yes. The plugin supports formatted code blocks with a copy button.

Does it support icons instead of buttons?

Yes. The Elementor widget supports an icon mode.

Does the plugin support Elementor?

Yes. A dedicated Elementor widget is included.
